name: seceon-siem
label: Seceon SIEM
description: Seceon SIEM provides integrations that allow you to retrieve alerts and close alerts with notes.

fields.title: Server URL
fields.description: Specify the server URL of the Doppel server to connect and perform automated operations.
fields.tooltip: Specify the server URL of the Doppel server to connect and perform automated operations.
fields.name: serverURL

fields.title: API Token
fields.tooltip: Specify the API token to connect to the endpoint and perform automated operations.
fields.description: Specify the API token to connect to the endpoint and perform automated operations.
fields.name: aPIToken

fields.title: Tenant ID
fields.description: Specify the tenant ID to connect to the endpoint and perform automated operations.
fields.name: tenantID
fields.tooltip: Default Tenant ID for API calls. Required when using a Global Auth Key that covers multiple tenants. Optional when using a Tenant-specific Auth Key.

fields.title: Verify SSL
fields.description: Specifies whether the SSL certificate for the server is to be verified. By default, this option is selected, i.e., set to true
fields.tooltip: Specifies whether the SSL certificate for the server is to be verified. By default, this option is selected, i.e., set to true
fields.name: verifySSL

operations.title: Get All Alerts
operations.description: Searches for alerts in Seceon OTM using one or more filter criteria.

parameters.title: Alert Type
parameters.description: Select one or more alert categories to filter alerts. Possible values are Brute Force Attack, Malware Infected Host, and Policy Violation.
parameters.name: alertType
parameters.tooltip: Select one or more alert categories to filter alerts. Possible values are Brute Force Attack, Malware Infected Host, and Policy Violation.

parameters.title: Alert Severity
parameters.description: Select one or more alert severity level to filter alerts. Possible values are CRITICAL, MAJOR, and MINOR.
parameters.name: alertSeverity
parameters.tooltip: Select one or more alert severity level to filter alerts. Possible values are CRITICAL, MAJOR, and MINOR.

parameters.title: Alert Status
parameters.description: Select one or more alert status to filter alerts. Possible values are OPEN and CLOSED.
parameters.name: alertStatus
parameters.tooltip: Select one or more alert status to filter alerts. Possible values are OPEN and CLOSED.

parameters.title: Confidence Score Range
parameters.description: Filter by confidence range (0-100) indicating how certain the system is about the threat.
parameters.name: confidenceScoreRange
parameters.tooltip: Filter by confidence range (0-100) indicating how certain the system is about the threat Example: {"from": 50, "to": 75}

parameters.title: Assigned To
parameters.description: Specify a comma-separated list of user email addresses to filter alerts assigned to specific users.
parameters.name: assignedTo
parameters.tooltip: Specify a comma-separated list of user email addresses to filter alerts assigned to specific users. Example: ["abc@example.com", "xyz@domain.com"] or abc@example.com, xyz@domain.com

parameters.title: Username
parameters.description: Specify a comma-separated list of usernames to filter alerts by the users associated with them.
parameters.name: username
parameters.tooltip: Specify a comma-separated list of usernames to filter alerts by the users associated with them. Example: ["USER1", "USER2"] or USER1, USER2

parameters.title: Create Time Range
parameters.description: Filter by date/time ranges when alerts were created.
parameters.name: createTimeRange
parameters.tooltip: Filter by date/time ranges when alerts were created. Example: {"from": "2019-02-08T17:32:28.000Z", "to": "2019-02-08T17:32:28.000Z"}

parameters.title: Update Time Range
parameters.description: Filter by date/time ranges when alerts were updated.
parameters.name: updateTimeRange
parameters.tooltip: Filter by date/time ranges when alerts were updated. Example: {"from": "2019-02-08T17:32:28.000Z", "to": "2019-02-08T17:32:28.000Z"}

parameters.title: Page Size
parameters.description: Number of alerts to return per page.
parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.tooltip: Number of alerts to return per page.

parameters.title: Scroll ID
parameters.description: Specify the Scroll ID returned by a previous Retrieve Alerts response to retrieve the next page of results. When provided, all filter parameters above are ignored. Each scroll context remains active for 5 minutes.
parameters.name: scrollID
parameters.tooltip: Specify the Scroll ID returned by a previous Retrieve Alerts response to retrieve the next page of results. When provided, all filter parameters above are ignored. Each scroll context remains active for 5 minutes.

parameters.title: Tenant ID
parameters.description: Override the default Tenant ID configured in the connector for this action. Required when using a Global Auth Key.
parameters.name: tenantID
parameters.tooltip: Override the default Tenant ID configured in the connector for this action. Required when using a Global Auth Key.

operations.title: Close Alert
operations.description: Closing an alert records investigation completion and sets status to CLOSED. Optional notes support audit and compliance.

parameters.title: Alert ID
parameters.description: Specify the unique Seceon OTM alert ID to close.
parameters.name: alertID
parameters.tooltip: Specify the unique Seceon OTM alert ID to close.

parameters.title: Closure Notes
parameters.description: Specify the closure notes explaining the reason for closing the alert.
parameters.name: closureNotes
parameters.tooltip: Specify the closure notes explaining the reason for closing the alert.

parameters.title: Performed By
parameters.description: Specify the email address of the analyst or system performing the closure action.
parameters.name: performedBy
parameters.tooltip: Specify the email address of the analyst or system performing the closure action.

parameters.title: Is Enforced
parameters.description: If enabled, Seceon OTM treats the provided information as authoritative and skips additional validation checks.
parameters.name: isEnforced
parameters.tooltip: If enabled, Seceon OTM treats the provided information as authoritative and skips additional validation checks.

parameters.title: Tenant ID
parameters.description: Override the default Tenant ID configured in the connector for this action. Required when using a Global Auth Key.
parameters.name: tenantID
parameters.tooltip: Override the default Tenant ID configured in the connector for this action. Required when using a Global Auth Key.

operations.title: Search Threat Indicator Alert
operations.description: Retrieve all threat indicators (evidence) that contributed to a specific alert. Threat indicators are the underlying suspicious events that, when correlated, triggered the alert.

parameters.title: Alert ID
parameters.description: Specify the unique Seceon OTM alert ID to search for threat indicators.
parameters.name: alertID
parameters.tooltip: Specify the unique Seceon OTM alert ID to search for threat indicators.

parameters.title: Source IPs
parameters.description: Specify a comma-separated list of source IP addresses to filter threat indicators by.
parameters.name: sourceIP
parameters.tooltip: Specify a comma-separated list of source IP addresses to filter threat indicators by. Example: ["10.10.10.100", "192.168.19.100"] or 10.10.10.100, 192.168.19.100

parameters.title: Destination IPs
parameters.description: Specify a comma-separated list of destination IP addresses to filter threat indicators by.
parameters.name: destinationIP
parameters.tooltip: Specify a comma-separated list of destination IP addresses to filter threat indicators by. Example: ["10.11.12.150", "192.168.19.3"] or 10.11.12.150, 192.168.19.3

parameters.title: Event Origin
parameters.description: Specify a comma-separated list of origin sources to filter threat indicators by.
parameters.name: eventOrigin
parameters.tooltip: Specify a comma-separated list of origin sources to filter threat indicators by. Example: ["Network", "Machine Learning"] or Network, Machine Learning
parameters.placeholder: For e.g ["Network", "Machine Learning"] or Network, Machine Learning

parameters.title: Event Type Name
parameters.description: Specify a comma-separated list of event type names to filter threat indicators by.
parameters.name: eventTypeName
parameters.tooltip: Specify a comma-separated list of event type names to filter threat indicators by. Example: ["Data Upload", "New Connection"] or Data Upload, New Connection
parameters.placeholder: For e.g ["Data Upload", "New Connection"] or Data Upload, New Connection

parameters.title: Source Data Type
parameters.description: Specify a comma-separated list of source data type to filter threat indicators by.
parameters.name: sourceDataType
parameters.tooltip: Specify a comma-separated list of source data type to filter threat indicators by. Example: ["netflow", "Linux"] or netflow, Linux

parameters.title: Username
parameters.description: Specify a comma-separated list of username to filter threat indicators by.
parameters.name: userName
parameters.tooltip: Specify a comma-separated list of username to filter threat indicators by. Example: ["USER1", "USER2"] or USER1, USER2

parameters.title: Timestamp Range
parameters.description: Filter threat indicators by timestamp range
parameters.name: timestampRange
parameters.tooltip: Filter threat indicators by timestamp range. Example: {"from": "2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z", "to": "2024-01-31T23:59:59.000Z"}

parameters.title: Page Size
parameters.description: Number of threat indicators to return per page. Minimum 10, maximum 500. Default is 20.
parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.tooltip: Number of threat indicators to return per page. Minimum 10, maximum 500. Default is 20.

parameters.title: Scroll ID
parameters.description: Specify the Scroll ID returned by a previous Retrieve Alerts response to retrieve the next page of results. When provided, all filter parameters above are ignored. Each scroll context remains active for 5 minutes.
parameters.name: scrollID
parameters.tooltip: Specify the Scroll ID returned by a previous Retrieve Alerts response to retrieve the next page of results. When provided, all filter parameters above are ignored. Each scroll context remains active for 5 minutes.

parameters.title: Tenant ID
parameters.description: Override the default Tenant ID configured in the connector for this action. Required when using a Global Auth Key.
parameters.name: tenantID
parameters.tooltip: Override the default Tenant ID configured in the connector for this action. Required when using a Global Auth Key.

operations.title: Execute API Request
operations.description: Execute an arbitrary HTTP request against the Seceon OTM REST API. Use this for endpoints not exposed as dedicated operations. The tenant_id from the connector configuration is applied automatically; override it via the Tenant ID parameter when needed.

parameters.title: HTTP Method
parameters.description: Select the HTTP method to use for the request.
parameters.name: method
parameters.tooltip: Select the HTTP method. Allowed values: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH.

parameters.title: Endpoint
parameters.description: Specify the API endpoint path, beginning with /.
parameters.name: endpoint
parameters.tooltip: Specify the API endpoint path beginning with /. Example: /api/v1/alert/search

parameters.title: Query Parameters
parameters.description: Optional JSON object of query string parameters to append to the request URL.
parameters.name: queryParams
parameters.tooltip: Optional JSON object of query parameters. Example: {"size": 50}

parameters.title: Request Body
parameters.description: Optional JSON body to send with POST, PUT, or PATCH requests.
parameters.name: requestBody
parameters.tooltip: Optional JSON body for POST, PUT, or PATCH requests. Example: {"alert_type": "Brute Force Attack"}

parameters.title: Tenant ID
parameters.description: Override the default Tenant ID configured in the connector for this action.
parameters.name: tenantID
parameters.tooltip: Override the default Tenant ID configured in the connector for this action. Required when using a Global Auth Key.
